author: Daniele Morais
title: Flood: alerta red for Nepal
subtitle: The global disaster alert system rates event "Enchente" at red (severe) level.
excerpt: Flood puts Nepal under red (severe) alert in the international GDACS system.
contentHtml:
GDACS, the global disaster alert and coordination system run by the UN and the European Commission, issued a red (severe) alert for event "Enchente" (flood) affecting Nepal.

From the official bulletin: On 26/08/2026, a flood started in Nepal, lasting until 28/08/2026 (last update). The flood caused 527 deaths and 0 displaced .

What the alert level means

GDACS rates events green, orange or red based on estimated humanitarian impact — exposed population, regional vulnerability and local response capacity.

With data from GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System).
